subject: prd/planner-driven-model-routing
statement: When the planner freezes a plan/v2 task for `/implement-now`, the planner shall record `reasoning`, `coupling`, `novelty`, `verification`, `impact_scope`, and `architectural_role` using the normative assessment vocabulary.
rationale: every executor task needs complete inputs so dispatch cannot fall through to an absent, cheapest, or hardcoded route
fit_criterion: every `/implement-now` plan/v2 golden carries exactly one accepted value for every field; missing and unknown values fail validation
